purpose: Consumer census anchor (WO-RET-01 step 1): every published subpath classified by consumption across the four consumer roots, plus the internal reachability census. Growth in consumerlessSubpaths / unreachableModules / testOnlyModules fails --check naming every new member; shrinkage never fails (retirements shrink it). stylesUnreferenced is reported, not ratcheted. exportsDigest pins the published subpath map; a drifted digest means the map moved and the baseline must be rewritten by a sighted --write.
